_comment: The known fleet. combine.py globs */totals.json, so a machine that has been
scanned appears on its own — this file exists for the ones that have NOT.
Without it, an unscanned computer is not reported as missing; it is simply
absent, and the overall total silently understates by however much that
machine holds. Listing it here makes the gap visible instead.
One entry per OS INSTALL, not per physical computer. The Dell Latitude 7480
is dual-booted and appears twice: each install has its own config dirs and
its own session files, and neither can see the other. Merging them under one
folder would hide which side the work happened on, and re-running a scanner
from the other OS would overwrite rather than add.
Adding a computer: append a row here, then run the scanners on it with
--out <folder>. Nothing else needs editing anywhere — every table, provider
